title: Amputation and ostomy status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM status codes this note supports.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hypertension.

HPI
Pt is an 83 y.o. female presenting for routine follow-up of HTN. Pt reports feeling well today. Denies any chest pain, shortness of breath, or dizziness. Pt notes she is managing her daily routine well. No new concerns expressed.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Amlodipine 5mg QD
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg QD

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 132/82, HR 74, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F.
CV: RRR, CTAB, no murmurs.
Resp: CTAB, no wheezes or crackles.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender. Colostomy is in place and appears healthy.
Ext: WNL.

Assessment
1. Hypertension: Well-controlled on current regimen.
2. Colostomy: Status post previous surgery, stable.

Plan
1. Continue current medications.
2. Continue monitoring BP.
3. Return to clinic in 3 months for routine f/u.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, PA-C
05/14/2026
explanations: Colostomy in place: Z93.3, colostomy status (HCC 463). Z43.3 is only for an encounter for care of the colostomy itself.

distractors.why: The colostomy is documented and present.
The visit is not for care of the colostomy; report the status, Z93.3.
